title: SpeedyHoppers
description: Customize hopper speed by transferring multiple items per cycle instead of vanilla's slow 1 item.
body:
## ⚡ SpeedyHoppers

SpeedyHoppers improves Minecraft hopper performance by allowing you to control how many items are transferred per cycle.

Instead of the default 1 item every ~0.4 seconds, you can configure hoppers to move multiple items at once — making item transport faster and more efficient.

---

## 🚀 Features

* 🔧 Adjustable items per transfer (`/hopper <amount>`)
* ⚡ Faster hopper systems without instant spam
* 💾 Persistent config (saves automatically)
* 👑 OP-only command control
* 🔁 Keeps vanilla-style timing (~0.4s per transfer)
* 🔥 Instant mode support (`/hopper 0`)

---

## ⚙️ Usage

```bash
/hopper <amount>
```

Examples:

* `/hopper 1` → Vanilla behavior
* `/hopper 8` → Transfers 8 items per cycle
* `/hopper 64` → Full stack per cycle
* `/hopper 0` → Instant transfer

---

## 📄 Configuration

```yaml
hopper_amount: 8
```

* This value is automatically updated when using the command
* Stored in `config.yml`

---

## 🧠 How it works

HopperFlux replaces vanilla hopper logic and processes item transfers manually, allowing precise control over transfer amounts while keeping consistent timing.

---

## ⚠️ Notes

* Designed for Paper 1.21+
* Large hopper networks may impact performance due to chunk scanning
* Redstone timing may differ slightly from vanilla

---

## 📦 Perfect for

* Survival servers
* Technical players
* Performance optimization
* Faster farms and item transport systems
